notes.label: Sweet spot: about 6 in from the end

claim.value: The sweet spot is a region about 5 to 7 in from the barrel end; the lab places it at 6 in.

source.label: Daniel A. Russell, Penn State — What (and where) is the sweet spot of a baseball/softball bat?

claim.note: It moves an inch or two between bats, so the lab’s 6 in is a middle value, not your bat’s.

claim.value: The flight uses a constant drag coefficient and a spin-dependent lift fit from baseball aerodynamics, applied to a 12 in softball.
